```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab with existing Chemist/Lab Id",
    "req_ids": ["U28_misc-1", "U28_misc-3"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Chemist/Lab Id exists"],
    "inputs": {"Chemist/Lab Id": "existing-id"},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Lab screen",
      "Enter Chemist/Lab Id in the input field",
      "Modify Chemist/Lab Name, Address, and Contact Details",
      "Submit changes"
    ],
    "expected": ["The updated details should be displayed and confirmed for existence"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym01",
    "title": "Handle non-existent Chemist/Lab Id exception",
    "req_ids": ["U28_misc-1"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Chemist/Lab Id does not exist"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to Edit/Update Chemist/Lab screen",
      "Attempt to enter a non-existent Chemist/Lab Id in the input field"
    ],
    "expected": ["An exception error message 'Chemist or Lab does not exist' should be displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym02",
    "title": "Handle deletion of Chemist/Lab with open Prescription Requests",
    "req_ids": ["U28_misc-3"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Chemist/Lab has open Prescription Requests"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to Delete Chemist/Lab screen",
      "Select Chemist/Lab with open Prescription Requests"
    ],
    "expected": ["An exception error message 'Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete' should be displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym03",
    "title": "Add Symptom Code via Add Symptom Code Screen",
    "req_ids": ["VCMSYM02"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["No Symptom Code exists"],
    "inputs": {"Symptom Code": "new-code"},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to Add Symptom Code screen",
      "Enter new Symptom Code",
      "Enter Symptom Description",
      "Submit new Symptom Code"
    ],
    "expected": ["The new Symptom Code and Description should be displayed and confirmed for existence"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym04",
    "title": "Edit/Update existing Symptom Code",
    "req_ids": ["VCMSYM03"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Symptom Code exists"],
    "inputs": {"Symptom Code": "existing-code"},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to Edit/Update Symptom Code screen",
      "Modify Symptom Code and Description",
      "Submit changes"
    ],
    "expected": ["The updated Symptom Code and Description should be displayed and confirmed for existence"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym05",
    "title": "Add Patient Profile with new Patient Id",
    "req_ids": ["VCPA01"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["No Patient Id exists"],
    "inputs": {"Patient Id": "new-id"},
    "steps": [
      "Register as a new patient with valid credentials",
      "Navigate to Update Patient Profile screen"
    ],
    "expected": ["Patient Id, Name, Age, Sex, Address, and Contact details should be captured and displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym06",
    "title": "Handle non-existent Patient Id exception",
    "req_ids": ["VCPA01"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Patient Id does not exist"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Attempt to register with an invalid Patient Id"
    ],
    "expected": ["An error message indicating invalid Patient Id should be displayed"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-0zym07",
    "title": "Generate Prescription Reports/Print Invoice after Patient Profile Update",
    "req_ids": ["VCPA01"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Patient Profile updated"],
    "inputs": {},
    "steps": [
      "Navigate to Consultation/Appointment Request View/Prescription Reports/Print Invoice screen",
      "Select appropriate options"
    ],
    "expected": ["Prescription reports/Invoice should be generated and displayed"]
  }
]
```
Note: The above JSON test cases are written in a structured format for clarity and understanding. The actual GUI Event Graphs notation would visually represent the flow and interactions between different screens and widgets, which is not possible to depict in plain text here. The GUI Event Graphs notation would typically include elements like "Screen", "Widget", "Event", "Action", and "Transition", with arrows or lines indicating the flow and dependencies between these elements.

In a real-world scenario, the GUI Event Graphs notation would be more graphical and would be used to visually map out the test cases, showing the sequence of screens, the user interactions, and the expected outcomes. The JSON format here is a simplified representation to convey the necessary information for test case creation.
